target: Frozen front-camera TwinLiteNet+ Medium v6 f0, unpadded white/yellow lane union IoU, low < 0.7. No per-weather change to truth in primary task.
observation_and_resampling: frame; intervals resample sites or whole laps/route-length bins as identified per source

controlled_hood.note: Each comparison matches all other factors. Only three sites and two hours. RGB residual variation incorporates simulator animation and encoding; not a physical sensor-noise model.

night_challenge.sample: Purposive challenge; 16 positions near historical training/calibration scenes; cannot estimate prevalence on arbitrary routes.

runtime_comparison.role: First newly captured changing-weather lap, deterministic sampling over the entire route; elapsed time per full-image method, one pinned host CPU core, OpenCV and BLAS single thread, model in memory, PNG read/decode excluded, precomputed matching f0 maps for band stacking. No real-time guarantee; native upper path currently builds all 10 bands before projection.

other_road_uncertainty.interpretation: Paired error differences on the same frames. Spatial clusters keep the same 20/50/100 m sections together across both passes, one new route only. Sensitivity to block width is not a between-map confidence interval.

gp_external_transfer.notice: Same fixed outcome on three new cohorts for each recipe selected during earlier search. Seeds are optimizer randomness, not independent road samples.

condition_abstention.source: Retrospective diagnostic: calibrate lower decile of stacked weather confidence and e-means distance upper 95%/gap lower 5% only on the original 12 calibration sites. Route only supported frames to corresponding 12-site weather cutoff, others to the exact same 12-site global cutoff. Fixed ground truth remains IoU < .7. No thresholds selected on these target scenes.

actual_transitions.window: 0–5 s after observed RPC acknowledgment; ignore ten seconds after each of 15 true changes for stable-period nuisance rate. Six no-change markers. e-means/robust weather-hour stream captured online, alternative weather classifiers recalculated on same raw RGB and frozen f0 outputs. “Detected” counts a label change regardless of class identity; identified target weather reported separately. Retrospective sensitivity, no online alert activation.

illumination_calibration.primary_future: 16 actual night challenge locations, acquired only after this freeze. Earlier static/drive sets are diagnostic. No recalibration on the challenge.

independent_rgb_container.sample_metadata: sample ID, path, view, split group and hash; no weather, time, Semantic, Depth, Instance or true IoU in score-stage data mounts
